Facility Tour Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement
This FACILITY TOUR CONFIDENTIALITY AND NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (this “Agreement”) is entered into as of this date: ____________ between Hydranautics, a California corporation (“Hydranautics”) and __________________ (“Visitor”).
During the facility tour(s), Visitor will observe Hydranautics’ business operations and facilities which may give Visitor access to some of Hydranautics’ Confidential Information as defined below.
Accordingly, as a condition of and in consideration of touring Hydranautics’ facilities, Visitor agrees that:
1. The term “Confidential Information” shall include all Hydranautics’ trade secrets and information that concerns the confidential business or affairs of Hydranautics and Nitto including without limitation, financial information and reports, business plans, design and construction plans, manufacturing processes, customer lists, employee data, forecasts, strategies, and all other proprietary business information.
2. Visitor agrees and acknowledges that in the course of, or incident to, the tour of Hydranautics’ facilities, Hydranutics may provide to, or Visitor will otherwise become exposed to Hydranautics’ Confidential Information.
3. Visitor agrees to hold the Confidential Information in the strictest confidence, and will exercise at least the same care with respect thereto as it exercises with respect to its’ own confidential or proprietary information and will not without Hydranautics’ consent use, divulge, copy, release, sell, loan or otherwise reveal such Confidential Information to others.
4. Visitor agrees he/she will not remove any document, equipment or other materials from the premises without Hydranautics’ written consent. Visitor will not photograph, videotape, or otherwise make any record of or preserve any Confidential Information to which he/she may be given access during the facility tour(s).
5. Visitor will abide by all safety regulations, stay within designated areas of the facility per the established tour, and will not leave the touring party without an escort by a Hydranautics authorized employee.
6. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.
7. This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties hereto with respect to the subject matter.
8. Visitor understands that his or her breach of this Agreement may subject him or her and his or her employees to liability.

完整来源中存在至少一个实际披露规范候选，所选单元覆盖全部发现的候选窗口。
已检查全部当前来源单元，没有实际内部人员或专业服务接收者披露规范候选。

检查完整当前来源，找出所有实际生效的内部人员或专业服务接收者披露规范候选，包括直接许可以及一般禁令中的明示人员类别例外。选择 candidate_found 时，证据应覆盖每个候选的统领句、接收者条款及紧邻条件；定义、序言、人员信息描述、仅需逐案另行授权的例外和处置条款不是候选。只有检查全部当前单元后才可选择 none_in_complete_source。原始 TRAIN 正例（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”；“The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case.”；“(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;”
窗口明示一个实际生效的类别化披露许可。
窗口给出披露禁令，同时对列明接收者类别形成真实许可例外。
窗口只有实际披露禁令，没有列明接收者类别许可。
窗口把人员类别置于保密义务范围，但省略了足以形成清晰披露许可的语言。
该窗口不是实际披露规范。

判断整个供应窗口表达的披露规范效力。只按来源实际措辞分类；不得把序言、定义或省略文字补成许可。一般禁令中对列明接收者类别的真实例外属于 prohibition_with_class_permission。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“(a) Subject to the restrictions set forth below in this Section 4, each Party may disclose the other Party’s Confidential Information to its directors, officers, employees, legal advisors, financial advisors and accountants, each bound by obligations of confidentiality consistent with this Agreement, who have a bona fide need to know (“Representatives”), but only to the extent necessary to carry out the Business Purpose. ”→operative_permission；“(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;”→prohibition_with_class_permission；“The obligations of the Parties shall be to hold and maintain the Confidential Information in the strictest of confidence at all times and to their agents, employees, representatives, affiliates, and any other individual or entity that is on a “need to know” basis.”→elliptical_recipient_confidentiality_scope。
所列人员均属于或服务于接收方本身。
所列人员属于接收方控制、被控制或共同控制的实体，而非接收方自身。
窗口同时列出接收方自身人员和关联或受控实体人员，或不同类别具有不同所有者。
窗口未清楚给出上述所有权关系。

判断窗口列明人员类别的所有者范围，保持接收方自身人员与其控制、被控制或共同控制实体的人员之区别。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→recipient_owned_people；“2.1.3 only to disclose the Confidential Information to employees of companies directly or indirectly owned or controlled by the Recipient, consultants and/or advisors to whom disclosure is necessary for the Permitted Purpose and then only on the understanding that such employees, consultants and/or advisors are expressly subject to the provisions of this Confidentiality Agreement.”→mixed_recipient_and_controlled_company_people；“2.3.2 the Recipient’s employees, officials, representatives and agents who have a strict need to know the contents of the Confidential Information, and employees, officials, representatives and agents of any legal entity that it controls, controls it, or with which it is under common control, who have a similar need to know the contents of the Confidential Information, provided that, for these purposes a controlled legal entity means:”→mixed_recipient_and_controlled_company_people。
窗口明示接收者须具有 need-to-know。
完整供应窗口没有陈述 need-to-know 条件；只判断该窗口。

判断供应披露窗口是否明示接收者必须具有 need-to-know；不得从必要目的或一般保密义务推断。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→need_to_know_required；“The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose.”→need_to_know_not_stated_in_window。
窗口要求书面保密协议或书面约束。
窗口要求保密约束，但没有要求另行书面协议。
完整供应窗口没有陈述接收者保密保障；只判断该窗口。

判断供应披露窗口对接收者规定的保密保障。区分书面协议要求与未要求书面形式的保密义务。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→written_confidentiality_required；“(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;”→confidentiality_required_without_separate_written_agreement；“The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case.”→no_safeguard_stated_in_window。
窗口明示披露或知识范围限于所述目的所必需的程度。
完整供应窗口没有陈述必要程度限制；只判断该窗口。

判断供应披露窗口是否把披露或接收者知识限制在为所述目的所必要的范围。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case.”→extent_necessary_required；“(c) to restrict access to Confidential Information to those of its officers, directors and employees who have a legitimate need-to-know to carry out the Purpose and who are obligated to protect such Confidential Information pursuant to terms and conditions no less protective of Discloser than those contained in this Agreement; and”→extent_limit_not_stated_in_window。
完整来源中存在至少一个实际处置义务，所选单元覆盖全部发现的候选窗口。
已检查全部当前来源单元，没有实际返还或销毁义务。

检查完整当前来源，找出所有实际返还或销毁受保护信息、其副本或相关材料的义务候选。证据必须覆盖动作、材料范围、触发条件及紧邻例外；仅有终止、存续、定义、不得保留或签署文字不是候选。只有检查全部当前单元后才能选择 none_in_complete_source。原始 TRAIN 正例（逐字）：“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”；“5.3 The Receiving Party shall return to SINTEC any and all information disclosed by SINTEC as well as any copies thereof automatically upon termination/expiration of the business relation- ship.”；“If requested, either Party shall be bound to return any and all materials to the Requesting Party within ____ days.” 原始 TRAIN 反例（逐字）：“Both parties further agree that their obligations under this paragraph survive the termination of the relationship between the two parties.”
窗口要求返还而未要求销毁。
窗口要求销毁而未要求返还。
窗口允许以返还或销毁二选一履行。
返还是通常动作，销毁仅在来源所述授权下替代返还。
窗口要求返还与销毁同时适用于各自材料范围。
窗口没有实际返还或销毁动作。

判断供应处置窗口要求的动作结构。区分返还或销毁二选一、须书面授权才可用销毁替代返还，以及针对不同材料同时返还并销毁。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→return_or_destroy_alternative；“2.1.7 upon demand of the OSCE, to promptly return all Confidential Information (in whatever medium), together with all copies thereof or, where expressly authorised in writing by the OSCE, to destroy or delete all such Confidential Information and shall confirm to the OSCE in writing that such destruction or deletion has taken place.”→return_or_authorized_destroy；“5.2.1 return all Confidential Information including copies to the disclosing Party; and 5.2.2 destroy or permanently erase all copies made by the receiving Party and procure that anyone to whom the receiving Party has supplied copies destroys or permanently erases such copies and any further copies made by them.”→return_and_destroy_distinct_scopes。
唯一实际触发是来源指定参与方的请求或要求。
唯一实际触发是协议终止或到期。
唯一实际触发是业务、工作或项目关系终止或到期。
唯一实际触发是人员服务终止。
唯一实际触发是规定期限内未建立预期关系。
协议终止或到期与请求均可触发。
业务、工作或项目关系终止与请求均可触发。
关系未建立期限与请求均可触发。
窗口有其他明示触发，须按逐字来源保留。
完整供应窗口没有陈述处置触发；只判断该窗口。

判断供应处置窗口的实际触发事件，不把请求、协议终止、业务或项目终止、服务终止、关系未建立期限相互替换。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“If requested, either Party shall be bound to return any and all materials to the Requesting Party within ____ days.”→request_only；“Volunteer further agrees that upon termination of service with CCPDT, Volunteer shall return within ten (10) business days all documents, files, electronic or otherwise, and property comprising Confidential Information of CCPDT and all copies, electronic or otherwise, thereof relating in any way to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ business, or in any way obtained during the course of service.”→service_termination_only；“5.3 The Receiving Party shall return to SINTEC any and all information disclosed by SINTEC as well as any copies thereof automatically upon termination/expiration of the business relation- ship.”→relationship_termination_only；“All Confidential Information in any form and any medium, including all copies thereof, disclosed to the Recipient shall be returned to UNHCR or destroyed: (a) if a business relationship is not entered into with UNHCR on or before the date which is three (3) months after the date both Parties have signed the Agreement; or (b) promptly upon request by the UNHCR at any time.”→relationship_nonformation_or_request。
明示范围是受保护信息本身，未明示副本或衍生材料。
明示范围包括受保护信息及其副本。
明示范围包括信息、副本以及笔记、分析、摘要或其他衍生材料。
动作仅针对副本或复制件。
来源明示全部相关材料，但其具体边界由逐字证据限定。
窗口给出其他明确材料范围，须按逐字来源保留。

判断供应处置窗口明示覆盖的材料层级，同时保留逐字来源以约束具体范围。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“If requested, either Party shall be bound to return any and all materials to the Requesting Party within ____ days.”→all_source_stated_materials；“5.3 The Receiving Party shall return to SINTEC any and all information disclosed by SINTEC as well as any copies thereof automatically upon termination/expiration of the business relation- ship.”→confidential_information_and_copies；“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→information_copies_and_derivatives。
窗口明示允许在处置过程后保留限定材料。
窗口明示禁止在处置过程后保留限定材料。
窗口对不同材料或条件同时明示有限留存许可和留存禁止。
完整供应窗口没有明示处置后留存许可或禁止；全量处置本身不改变此选择。

判断供应窗口是否明示处置后的留存许可或留存禁止。不得仅因要求返还或销毁全部材料就称其为 explicit retention prohibition。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law. ”→explicit_retention_permission；“Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.”→explicit_retention_prohibition；“However, notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, 1) neither party will be required to delete electronic Confidential Information stored in back-up/archival storage in accordance with its policies, provided that any such retained Confidential Information will continue to be subject to the terms of this Confidentiality Agreement until it is destroyed by the receiving party; and”→explicit_retention_permission；“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→no_explicit_retention_effect_in_window。

Title:

choices.meaning: 完整来源中存在至少一个实际披露规范候选，所选单元覆盖全部发现的候选窗口。
choices.name: candidate_found

choices.meaning: 已检查全部当前来源单元，没有实际内部人员或专业服务接收者披露规范候选。
choices.name: none_in_complete_source

operations.name: positive_disclosure_norm_locator_v1
operations.question: 检查完整当前来源，找出所有实际生效的内部人员或专业服务接收者披露规范候选，包括直接许可以及一般禁令中的明示人员类别例外。选择 candidate_found 时，证据应覆盖每个候选的统领句、接收者条款及紧邻条件；定义、序言、人员信息描述、仅需逐案另行授权的例外和处置条款不是候选。只有检查全部当前单元后才可选择 none_in_complete_source。原始 TRAIN 正例（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”；“The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case.”；“(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;”

choices.meaning: 窗口明示一个实际生效的类别化披露许可。
choices.name: operative_permission

choices.meaning: 窗口给出披露禁令，同时对列明接收者类别形成真实许可例外。
choices.name: prohibition_with_class_permission

choices.meaning: 窗口只有实际披露禁令，没有列明接收者类别许可。
choices.name: operative_prohibition_only

choices.meaning: 窗口把人员类别置于保密义务范围，但省略了足以形成清晰披露许可的语言。
choices.name: elliptical_recipient_confidentiality_scope

choices.meaning: 该窗口不是实际披露规范。
choices.name: not_an_operative_disclosure_norm

operations.name: disclosure_norm_effect_v1
operations.question: 判断整个供应窗口表达的披露规范效力。只按来源实际措辞分类；不得把序言、定义或省略文字补成许可。一般禁令中对列明接收者类别的真实例外属于 prohibition_with_class_permission。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“(a) Subject to the restrictions set forth below in this Section 4, each Party may disclose the other Party’s Confidential Information to its directors, officers, employees, legal advisors, financial advisors and accountants, each bound by obligations of confidentiality consistent with this Agreement, who have a bona fide need to know (“Representatives”), but only to the extent necessary to carry out the Business Purpose. ”→operative_permission；“(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;”→prohibition_with_class_permission；“The obligations of the Parties shall be to hold and maintain the Confidential Information in the strictest of confidence at all times and to their agents, employees, representatives, affiliates, and any other individual or entity that is on a “need to know” basis.”→elliptical_recipient_confidentiality_scope。

choices.meaning: 所列人员均属于或服务于接收方本身。
choices.name: recipient_owned_people

choices.meaning: 所列人员属于接收方控制、被控制或共同控制的实体，而非接收方自身。
choices.name: controlled_company_people

choices.meaning: 窗口同时列出接收方自身人员和关联或受控实体人员，或不同类别具有不同所有者。
choices.name: mixed_recipient_and_controlled_company_people

choices.meaning: 窗口未清楚给出上述所有权关系。
choices.name: other_or_unspecified_owner

operations.name: disclosure_owner_scope_v1
operations.question: 判断窗口列明人员类别的所有者范围，保持接收方自身人员与其控制、被控制或共同控制实体的人员之区别。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→recipient_owned_people；“2.1.3 only to disclose the Confidential Information to employees of companies directly or indirectly owned or controlled by the Recipient, consultants and/or advisors to whom disclosure is necessary for the Permitted Purpose and then only on the understanding that such employees, consultants and/or advisors are expressly subject to the provisions of this Confidentiality Agreement.”→mixed_recipient_and_controlled_company_people；“2.3.2 the Recipient’s employees, officials, representatives and agents who have a strict need to know the contents of the Confidential Information, and employees, officials, representatives and agents of any legal entity that it controls, controls it, or with which it is under common control, who have a similar need to know the contents of the Confidential Information, provided that, for these purposes a controlled legal entity means:”→mixed_recipient_and_controlled_company_people。

choices.meaning: 窗口明示接收者须具有 need-to-know。
choices.name: need_to_know_required

choices.meaning: 完整供应窗口没有陈述 need-to-know 条件；只判断该窗口。
choices.name: need_to_know_not_stated_in_window

operations.name: need_to_know_requirement_v1
operations.question: 判断供应披露窗口是否明示接收者必须具有 need-to-know；不得从必要目的或一般保密义务推断。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→need_to_know_required；“The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose.”→need_to_know_not_stated_in_window。

choices.meaning: 窗口要求书面保密协议或书面约束。
choices.name: written_confidentiality_required

choices.meaning: 窗口要求保密约束，但没有要求另行书面协议。
choices.name: confidentiality_required_without_separate_written_agreement

choices.meaning: 完整供应窗口没有陈述接收者保密保障；只判断该窗口。
choices.name: no_safeguard_stated_in_window

operations.name: confidentiality_safeguard_v1
operations.question: 判断供应披露窗口对接收者规定的保密保障。区分书面协议要求与未要求书面形式的保密义务。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→written_confidentiality_required；“(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;”→confidentiality_required_without_separate_written_agreement；“The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case.”→no_safeguard_stated_in_window。

choices.meaning: 窗口明示披露或知识范围限于所述目的所必需的程度。
choices.name: extent_necessary_required

choices.meaning: 完整供应窗口没有陈述必要程度限制；只判断该窗口。
choices.name: extent_limit_not_stated_in_window

operations.name: extent_necessity_requirement_v1
operations.question: 判断供应披露窗口是否把披露或接收者知识限制在为所述目的所必要的范围。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case.”→extent_necessary_required；“(c) to restrict access to Confidential Information to those of its officers, directors and employees who have a legitimate need-to-know to carry out the Purpose and who are obligated to protect such Confidential Information pursuant to terms and conditions no less protective of Discloser than those contained in this Agreement; and”→extent_limit_not_stated_in_window。

choices.meaning: 完整来源中存在至少一个实际处置义务，所选单元覆盖全部发现的候选窗口。
choices.name: candidate_found

choices.meaning: 已检查全部当前来源单元，没有实际返还或销毁义务。
choices.name: none_in_complete_source

operations.name: positive_disposal_norm_locator_v1
operations.question: 检查完整当前来源，找出所有实际返还或销毁受保护信息、其副本或相关材料的义务候选。证据必须覆盖动作、材料范围、触发条件及紧邻例外；仅有终止、存续、定义、不得保留或签署文字不是候选。只有检查全部当前单元后才能选择 none_in_complete_source。原始 TRAIN 正例（逐字）：“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”；“5.3 The Receiving Party shall return to SINTEC any and all information disclosed by SINTEC as well as any copies thereof automatically upon termination/expiration of the business relation- ship.”；“If requested, either Party shall be bound to return any and all materials to the Requesting Party within ____ days.” 原始 TRAIN 反例（逐字）：“Both parties further agree that their obligations under this paragraph survive the termination of the relationship between the two parties.”

choices.meaning: 窗口要求返还而未要求销毁。
choices.name: return_only

choices.meaning: 窗口要求销毁而未要求返还。
choices.name: destroy_only

choices.meaning: 窗口允许以返还或销毁二选一履行。
choices.name: return_or_destroy_alternative

choices.meaning: 返还是通常动作，销毁仅在来源所述授权下替代返还。
choices.name: return_or_authorized_destroy

choices.meaning: 窗口要求返还与销毁同时适用于各自材料范围。
choices.name: return_and_destroy_distinct_scopes

choices.meaning: 窗口没有实际返还或销毁动作。
choices.name: not_a_disposal_action

operations.name: disposal_action_profile_v1
operations.question: 判断供应处置窗口要求的动作结构。区分返还或销毁二选一、须书面授权才可用销毁替代返还，以及针对不同材料同时返还并销毁。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→return_or_destroy_alternative；“2.1.7 upon demand of the OSCE, to promptly return all Confidential Information (in whatever medium), together with all copies thereof or, where expressly authorised in writing by the OSCE, to destroy or delete all such Confidential Information and shall confirm to the OSCE in writing that such destruction or deletion has taken place.”→return_or_authorized_destroy；“5.2.1 return all Confidential Information including copies to the disclosing Party; and 5.2.2 destroy or permanently erase all copies made by the receiving Party and procure that anyone to whom the receiving Party has supplied copies destroys or permanently erases such copies and any further copies made by them.”→return_and_destroy_distinct_scopes。

choices.meaning: 唯一实际触发是来源指定参与方的请求或要求。
choices.name: request_only

choices.meaning: 唯一实际触发是协议终止或到期。
choices.name: agreement_termination_only

choices.meaning: 唯一实际触发是业务、工作或项目关系终止或到期。
choices.name: relationship_termination_only

choices.meaning: 唯一实际触发是人员服务终止。
choices.name: service_termination_only

choices.meaning: 唯一实际触发是规定期限内未建立预期关系。
choices.name: relationship_nonformation_only

choices.meaning: 协议终止或到期与请求均可触发。
choices.name: agreement_termination_or_request

choices.meaning: 业务、工作或项目关系终止与请求均可触发。
choices.name: relationship_termination_or_request

choices.meaning: 关系未建立期限与请求均可触发。
choices.name: relationship_nonformation_or_request

choices.meaning: 窗口有其他明示触发，须按逐字来源保留。
choices.name: other_explicit_trigger

choices.meaning: 完整供应窗口没有陈述处置触发；只判断该窗口。
choices.name: no_trigger_stated_in_window

operations.name: disposal_trigger_profile_v1
operations.question: 判断供应处置窗口的实际触发事件，不把请求、协议终止、业务或项目终止、服务终止、关系未建立期限相互替换。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“If requested, either Party shall be bound to return any and all materials to the Requesting Party within ____ days.”→request_only；“Volunteer further agrees that upon termination of service with CCPDT, Volunteer shall return within ten (10) business days all documents, files, electronic or otherwise, and property comprising Confidential Information of CCPDT and all copies, electronic or otherwise, thereof relating in any way to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ business, or in any way obtained during the course of service.”→service_termination_only；“5.3 The Receiving Party shall return to SINTEC any and all information disclosed by SINTEC as well as any copies thereof automatically upon termination/expiration of the business relation- ship.”→relationship_termination_only；“All Confidential Information in any form and any medium, including all copies thereof, disclosed to the Recipient shall be returned to UNHCR or destroyed: (a) if a business relationship is not entered into with UNHCR on or before the date which is three (3) months after the date both Parties have signed the Agreement; or (b) promptly upon request by the UNHCR at any time.”→relationship_nonformation_or_request。

choices.meaning: 明示范围是受保护信息本身，未明示副本或衍生材料。

choices.name: other_explicit_material_scope

operations.name: disposal_material_scope_v1
operations.question: 判断供应处置窗口明示覆盖的材料层级，同时保留逐字来源以约束具体范围。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“If requested, either Party shall be bound to return any and all materials to the Requesting Party within ____ days.”→all_source_stated_materials；“5.3 The Receiving Party shall return to SINTEC any and all information disclosed by SINTEC as well as any copies thereof automatically upon termination/expiration of the business relation- ship.”→confidential_information_and_copies；“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→information_copies_and_derivatives。

choices.name: explicit_retention_permission

choices.meaning: 窗口明示禁止在处置过程后保留限定材料。
choices.name: explicit_retention_prohibition

choices.meaning: 窗口对不同材料或条件同时明示有限留存许可和留存禁止。
choices.name: both_permission_and_prohibition

choices.meaning: 完整供应窗口没有明示处置后留存许可或禁止；全量处置本身不改变此选择。
choices.name: no_explicit_retention_effect_in_window

operations.name: post_disposal_retention_effect_v1
operations.question: 判断供应窗口是否明示处置后的留存许可或留存禁止。不得仅因要求返还或销毁全部材料就称其为 explicit retention prohibition。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law. ”→explicit_retention_permission；“Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.”→explicit_retention_prohibition；“However, notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, 1) neither party will be required to delete electronic Confidential Information stored in back-up/archival storage in accordance with its policies, provided that any such retained Confidential Information will continue to be subject to the terms of this Confidentiality Agreement until it is destroyed by the receiving party; and”→explicit_retention_permission；“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→no_explicit_retention_effect_in_window。

Facility Tour Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement
This FACILITY TOUR CONFIDENTIALITY AND NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (this “Agreement”) is entered into as of this date: ____________ between Hydranautics, a California corporation (“Hydranautics”) and __________________ (“Visitor”).
During the facility tour(s), Visitor will observe Hydranautics’ business operations and facilities which may give Visitor access to some of Hydranautics’ Confidential Information as defined below.
Accordingly, as a condition of and in consideration of touring Hydranautics’ facilities, Visitor agrees that:
1. The term “Confidential Information” shall include all Hydranautics’ trade secrets and information that concerns the confidential business or affairs of Hydranautics and Nitto including without limitation, financial information and reports, business plans, design and construction plans, manufacturing processes, customer lists, employee data, forecasts, strategies, and all other proprietary business information.
2. Visitor agrees and acknowledges that in the course of, or incident to, the tour of Hydranautics’ facilities, Hydranutics may provide to, or Visitor will otherwise become exposed to Hydranautics’ Confidential Information.
3. Visitor agrees to hold the Confidential Information in the strictest confidence, and will exercise at least the same care with respect thereto as it exercises with respect to its’ own confidential or proprietary information and will not without Hydranautics’ consent use, divulge, copy, release, sell, loan or otherwise reveal such Confidential Information to others.
4. Visitor agrees he/she will not remove any document, equipment or other materials from the premises without Hydranautics’ written consent. Visitor will not photograph, videotape, or otherwise make any record of or preserve any Confidential Information to which he/she may be given access during the facility tour(s).
5. Visitor will abide by all safety regulations, stay within designated areas of the facility per the established tour, and will not leave the touring party without an escort by a Hydranautics authorized employee.
6. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.
7. This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties hereto with respect to the subject matter.
8. Visitor understands that his or her breach of this Agreement may subject him or her and his or her employees to liability.
Title: ______________________________________________
Company Name: _____________________________________
Visitor Name/Signature _______________________________
(To sign, type your name above)
